run_revision.correction: new revision with supersedes_revision_id and correction_reason
run_revision.sample_provenance: append-only SampleRevisionAssociation snapshot per locked revision

ambient_measurements.not_measured: store an explicit source_type without value, time, or sensor

source_load.ingredients: one or more MaterialLot version references

preparation_operations.gas_source_identity: frozen MaterialLot gas-cylinder version; one premixed cylinder is one source, while on-site mixing references each physical cylinder
